disposition.note: Rewrote the migration line in section 13 to the V0001..Vnnnn form using the next free rwb-case sequence number; the number itself is not in the source documents (CG-ALL-3765).

edits.old: - Migration `V1045_1__product_parameter_projection.sql` in the per-service Flyway sequence of rwb-case adds three indexes and no column: `ix_case_status_queue ON recovery_case (status, queue_id)` for the open-case count, `ix_timer_case_expiry ON timer (case_id, expires_at)` for the timers answer, and `ix_parameter_value_lookup ON parameter_value (param_key, product_group, valid_from)` for the version-in-force lookup.
edits.new: - Migration in the `V0001` to `Vnnnn` form of the per-service Flyway sequence of rwb-case, using the next free number of that sequence (the number is Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-3765)), adds three indexes and no column: `ix_case_status_queue ON recovery_case (status, queue_id)` for the open-case count, `ix_timer_case_expiry ON timer (case_id, expires_at)` for the timers answer, and `ix_parameter_value_lookup ON parameter_value (param_key, product_group, valid_from)` for the version-in-force lookup.
